scientific.integrity: The primary fractional-illumination paper was inspected in complete open full text, and the closest later cube-local theorem was inspected in open full text. Exact-object, alias, low-dimensional prism, and tangent-cone searches found no covering theorem. The proof is exact; finite code is a regression check only.
limitations: The theorem is restricted to Cartesian products of simplices and does not claim multiplicativity for arbitrary product polytopes.
It verifies the ordinary and fractional illumination conjectural bounds only on this class.
The proof is elementary enough that an equivalent tangent-cone observation may exist implicitly in older literature.

title: Exact ordinary and fractional illumination of every product of simplices
